g.text: A Retried Request Becomes a Safe No-Op
The dedupe check runs BEFORE the increment, so a timeout-triggered retry can't double-count points
Both requests carry the SAME idempotency key (match_id:user_id) because they represent the same logical event, not two different ones.
The dedupe store's setIfAbsent is itself atomic -- there's no window where both requests could see "absent" and both proceed to increment.
